meta.title: Where Nothing Was Found
meta.grain: one row per people group with no Scripture, film or Door43 resource in the pools this build checked
meta.the_finding: 1,592 people groups, 205,861,745 people. 183 of them speak a sign language.
meta.not_proof_of_absence: ABSENT FROM THE POOLS CHECKED, never proof that nothing exists. Each row carries its own checked_pools and unchecked_pools so an exported copy cannot be read as a claim about the world.
meta.audio_never_checked: AUDIO HAS NEVER BEEN SEARCHED FOR ANY GROUP ON THIS MAP. GRN is the main audio-gospel pool and needs credentials this build does not have, so for an oral culture the most relevant resource is the one pool nobody has looked in.
meta.sign_languages: A sign language cannot be served by a text translation at all, so a text pool was never the right place to look for the rows flagged sign_language.
meta.gap_kind_note: Four situations share this table and only the last is a translation problem. Sign language and private-use OVERLAP COMPLETELY here — every private-use code in this gap is a sign language — so filtering to gap_kind="sign language" alone understates the Deaf share; add the private-use rows to get the true figure. The "GRN not yet swept" rows will resolve themselves as the crawl proceeds and are not evidence of absence.
meta.doctrine_boundary: Only sources publishing the 66-book canon are searched. Watchtower/JW, Seventh-day Adventist, LDS and other added-canon publishers are excluded by rule, which is why some languages they do publish in appear here.
meta.no_believer_data: This table describes PUBLISHED RESOURCES only. It carries no church, believer or meeting-point data and must never gain any.
